$comment: F-11 round 1 exception requests for the six SCR-13 rules boards. None is approved yet; the design engineer records each decision. Board data disagreements (8 vs 7 Not set, archive Not set vs 'Keep, never purge') are handled with one mock scenario per board (PMO-0-4, A-1). Other requests that do not show as tool misses: AREA texts and breadcrumb SETUP/RULES as links (A-8), board '#' actions built as buttons and 'Set BU totals rules' (A-12), undrawn states (A-13), phone back link and RULES label under the app's phone bar (D-08, A-14), phones read-only (A-6, D-15).
